title: senna singueana
intro: Senna singueana, commonly known as the East African senna, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting bowel movements. The therapeutic actions of Senna singueana include its laxative properties and potential anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of constipation and other gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Senna singueana include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
